title: Modular PCB Fixture
what: A modular and cost-effective PCB fixture designed to support multiple board layouts using interchangeable pogo pin plates and adjustable mounting features. Includes a quick-lock lid mechanism that secures the PCB onto a spring-loaded plate for fast and reliable connection setup.
why: To reduce cost and provide a flexible testing solution for prototype PCBs, which frequently change in design and require a fixture that can adapt without needing a full rebuild. This design offered a reusable, adaptable, and far more cost-effective alternative to rigid and expensive commercial options.
how: Modeled in SolidWorks with a removable pogo pin plate and spring-loaded base to accommodate different board sizes. Fabricated the enclosure using 3D printing and Dremeled ABS enclosure. Designed the layout for easy internal wiring access, reducing testing setup time and supporting quick board layout swaps.
